error_text: SC2089: Quotes/backslashes in this variable will not be respected. SC2090: Expansions will cause this to break.
root_cause: FILES_ARG/DRY_FLAG built as strings in WEC fast-forward job; word-split on expansion corrupts arguments
fix_template: Use Bash arrays: FILES_ARG=(); read -ra _FL <<<"$FF_FILES"; FILES_ARG=(--files "${_FL[@]}"); cmd "${FILES_ARG[@]}"

fix_applied: Converted FILES_ARG/DRY_FLAG to Bash arrays in workflow-execution-gate.yml fast-forward job; use read -ra and expand via ${FILES_ARG[@]}

error_text: ZipFile.extractall() is vulnerable to Zip Slip (path traversal). Crafted archive members like ../... can write outside target directory.
root_cause: ZipFile.extractall(tmp) in install_skill() does not validate member paths before extraction
fix_template: Iterate zf.infolist(), resolve each member_path, assert str(member_path).startswith(str(tmp.resolve())), then call zf.extractall()

fix_applied: Added Zip Slip guard in compression.py install_skill(): validate each ZipInfo member path resolves inside tmp before extractall()

error_text: NameError: name '_repo_root' is not defined at module level
root_cause: _DEFAULT_AGENTS_ROOT called _repo_root() before the function was defined in doc_loader.py

fix_applied: Moved _repo_root() function definition before _DEFAULT_AGENTS_ROOT module-level assignment in doc_loader.py

error_text: Module docstring for test_failure_matcher/handler.py references P19 but all pattern_ids use RP-... format
root_cause: Stale docstring from initial implementation; pattern_id format was later standardised to RP-...
fix_template: Update docstring: 'classified by known pattern IDs (RP-019, RP-009, RP-XDIST-WORKER, etc.)'

fix_applied: Updated docstring in test_failure_matcher/handler.py: replaced P19 reference with RP-019, added RP-XDIST-WORKER format note

lessons: Always move helper functions before module-level calls; Bash arrays prevent SC2089/SC2090; Zip Slip requires explicit member-path validation before extractall()

error_text: 31% failure rate (310/1000 runs). 266/310 failures are self-healing pattern (SELF_HEALING_001). Cascade: healer triggers on meta-workflows it cannot fix; escalate job posts comments without cooldown causing workflow_run chain.
root_cause: Healer exclusion list missing 12 CI meta-workflows + no escalation cooldown + no per-branch hourly cap
fix_template: Expand exclusion list + add rate_cap guard (>=10/hr brake) + add dedup to escalate job (30min cooldown)
verification_cmd: Monitor iterative-self-healing-ci.yml failure rate; target <1% after fix

fix_applied: Added 12 exclusions, per-branch hourly cap (>=10 runs), 30-min escalation dedup guard, 30-min copilot-iterative-self-healing cooldown
